brief:
Shehab Wire reported that the first winter low-pressure system submerged 70,000 tents across Gaza, with children killed in the flooding. The disaster struck displaced populations living in makeshift shelters amid the territory's ongoing humanitarian crisis.

The incident has raised questions about the international community's response to conditions in Gaza, where hundreds of thousands remain in tent encampments vulnerable to severe weather.

title: Winter storm floods 70,000 tents in Gaza, killing children
